{{Quote|Overseer, this is Second Chance...|[[Rej Taunt]]'s pilot hailing the ''Overseer''|<ref name="Millennium Falcon (novel)">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>}}
The '''''Overseer''''' was an [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class]] assault vessel in the service of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was destroyed by [[Pistoeka sabotage droid/Legends|buzz droids]] jettisoned from the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Second Chance'']].<ref name="Millennium Falcon (novel)" />
